metadata.title: Replace hardcoded user roles with configurable settings
metadata.author: madhav165

description:
# 🐛 Bug-fix PR

Closes #2908

---

## Summary

- Replace hardcoded role names (`platform_admin`, `platform_viewer`, `team_admin`) in `email_auth_service` with configurable settings (`DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_USER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_OWNER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE`)
- Add Alembic data migration to update existing `user_roles` assignments when configured roles differ from previous hardcoded defaults
- Add RBAC role assignment when team members are added/removed via `team_management_service`
- Add corresponding Helm chart values and `.env.example` documentation

## Changes

### `mcpgateway/config.py`

- Added `default_admin_role`, `default_user_role`, `default_team_owner_role`, `default_team_member_role` settings with backward-compatible defaults

### `mcpgateway/services/email_auth_service.py`

- `create_user`: Uses `settings.default_admin_role` / `settings.default_user_role` for global role and `settings.default_team_owner_role` for personal team role
- `update_user`: Uses `settings.default_admin_role` / `settings.default_user_role` for promotion/demotion logic

### `mcpgateway/services/team_management_service.py`

- Added lazy-initialized `role_service` property to avoid circular imports
- `add_member_to_team`: Assigns team-scoped RBAC role (`DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE`) to new/reactivated members
- `remove_member_from_team`: Revokes team-scoped RBAC role when members are removed
- `update_member_role`: Transitions RBAC roles when membership role changes (member ↔ owner)
- `approve_join_request`: Assigns team-scoped RBAC role to approved join request members

### `mcpgateway/alembic/versions/ba202ac1665f_migrate_user_roles_to_configurable_.py`

- Data migration that updates existing `user_roles` when configured defaults differ from previous hardcoded values
- No-op when settings match old defaults (backward compatible)
- Supports both PostgreSQL and SQLite (uses Python uuid generation instead of `gen_random_uuid()`)
- Creates team-scoped roles for existing team members who don't have any

### `charts/mcp-stack/values.yaml`

- Added `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_USER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_OWNER_ROLE`, `DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE` under new "Default Role Configuration" section

### `.env.example`

- Documented all four new environment variables with defaults

## 🧪 Verification

| Check            | Command                                                                                                                           | Status |
| ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| Unit tests       | `pytest tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_email_auth_service.py tests/unit/mcpgateway/services/test_team_management_service.py` | pass   |
| Migration syntax | `python -m py_compile`                                                                                                            | pass   |

## 📐 MCP Compliance (if relevant)

- [x] Matches current MCP spec
- [x] No breaking change to MCP clients

## ✅ Checklist

- [x] Code formatted
- [x] No secrets/credentials committed
- [x] Backward compatible (defaults match previous hardcoded values)

reviews.author: crivetimihai
reviews.body:
## Review: Rebased onto main & fixed critical issues

Rebased the branch onto current `main` (no conflicts). During code review, I found and fixed the following issues in commit `2da05348`:

### Critical fixes applied

1. **Alembic migration `down_revision` was wrong** — pointed to `c1c2c3c4c5c6` instead of the actual head `a31c6ffc2239`, creating two alembic heads which would break `alembic upgrade head`.

2. **Duplicate code block in migration** — lines 146-161 contained a copy-pasted duplicate UPDATE that always returned 0 rows. Removed the duplicate and scoped the remaining block to only target non-self-granted rows (self-granted are already handled by `_migrate_role`).

3. **`remove_member_from_team` only revoked member role, never owner role** — when an owner was removed from a team, only `default_team_member_role` was revoked. The `default_team_owner_role` RBAC role was left dangling, allowing removed owners to retain team-admin permissions. Fixed to check `membership.role` and revoke the correct RBAC role.

4. **Migration INSERT missing `granted_at`** — the raw SQL INSERT for backfilling team member roles omitted the `granted_at` column, which is `NOT NULL` without a server-side default. Would fail at runtime. Added `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`.

5. **SSO service still hardcoded `"platform_admin"`** — 4 instances in `sso_service.py` were not updated to use `settings.default_admin_role`, making the SSO admin group mapping ignore the new configuration. Fixed + updated test mocks.

6. **Incomplete migration downgrade** — `upgrade()` creates new rows (`granted_by='system_migration'`) and migrates non-self-granted roles, but `downgrade()` didn't reverse either. Added both.

### Test results

- **11,304 passed**, 224 skipped, 2 failed (pre-existing in `test_tool_service_coverage.py`, unrelated)
- Alembic: single head confirmed
- Flake8: clean

commits.message:
feat: assign RBAC roles when team members are added or removed

- Add RoleService lazy initialization to TeamManagementService
- Assign team-scoped RBAC role when adding members via add_member_to_team
- Assign team-scoped RBAC role when approving join requests
- Revoke team-scoped RBAC role when removing team members
- Add unit tests for role assignment and revocation
- Fix existing test to mock role service

This closes the gap where DEFAULT_TEAM_MEMBER_ROLE was not applied
when users were added to teams through admin UI or join requests.

commits.message:
fix: resolve critical issues in configurable role settings implementation

- Fix alembic migration down_revision to point to actual head (a31c6ffc2239)
  eliminating multiple-heads breakage
- Remove duplicate UPDATE block in migration upgrade (copy-paste bug)
- Add missing granted_at to migration INSERT avoiding NOT NULL violation
- Fix remove_member_from_team to revoke correct RBAC role based on
  membership.role (owner vs member) instead of always revoking member role
- Replace hardcoded "platform_admin" in sso_service with
  settings.default_admin_role for consistency
- Fix incomplete migration downgrade: revert non-self-granted roles and
  clean up system_migration rows
- Update SSO test mocks with default_admin_role setting

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>

fix: disable plugin manager in tool lookup tests

The invoke_tool tests that reach the plugin metadata section
(line 2940) fail because PydanticTool.model_validate() cannot
validate MagicMock attributes. Set _plugin_manager = None since
these tests exercise lookup prioritization logic, not plugins.

Cherry-picked from 473f0f65 (lost during squash merge of #2924).
